scope: Read-only catalog and has_*_privilege inspection of the two explicitly authorized Dartflow projects.

declaredColumnUpdateGrants.purpose: PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE requires UPDATE privilege on at least one column of the locked table.
declaredColumnUpdateGrants.boundary: These are real column UPDATE grants, so those two columns are not read-only. No INSERT, DELETE, table-wide UPDATE, TRUNCATE or TRIGGER privilege is granted on the administration tables; no other administration column UPDATE grants exist.

queryMethod.membershipTraversal: Recursive catalog traversal of all granted roles; SET targets also checked with pg_has_role(..., 'SET') on PostgreSQL 16+.
queryMethod.relationFiltering: Materialized table/sequence catalog sets keep has_sequence_privilege limited to actual sequences.
queryMethod.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
app AS (SELECT oid,rolname,rolsuper,rolcreatedb,rolcreaterole,rolinherit,rolreplication,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='dartflow_app'),
private AS (SELECT oid,nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='dartflow_private'),
membership AS (
  SELECT m.roleid,m.member,1 AS depth,ARRAY[m.member,m.roleid] AS path
  FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN app a ON a.oid=m.member
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.roleid,m.member,w.depth+1,w.path||m.roleid
  FROM membership w JOIN pg_auth_members m ON m.member=w.roleid
  WHERE NOT m.roleid=ANY(w.path)
),
tables AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relowner,c.relrowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN private n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p')),
sequences AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN private n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='S'),
api_roles AS (SELECT oid,rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')),
admin_tables AS (SELECT * FROM tables WHERE relname IN ('schema_migrations','profiles','clubs','club_memberships','event_staff','events','boards')),
append_only AS (SELECT * FROM tables WHERE relname IN ('audit_events','action_receipts','match_results','match_players'))
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'checked_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
 'server_version_num',current_setting('server_version_num')::int,
 'runtime_role',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('exists',true,'superuser',rolsuper,'create_database',rolcreatedb,'create_role',rolcreaterole,'inherit',rolinherit,'replication',rolreplication,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls) FROM app),
 'memberships',jsonb_build_object(
   'direct_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN app a ON a.oid=m.member),
   'reachable_count',(SELECT count(DISTINCT roleid) FROM membership),
   'reachable_roles',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT r.rolname ORDER BY r.rolname) FROM membership m JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=m.roleid),'[]'::jsonb),
   'indirect_set_role_targets',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r.rolname ORDER BY r.rolname) FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN app a WHERE r.oid<>a.oid AND CASE WHEN current_setting('server_version_num')::int>=160000 THEN pg_has_role(a.oid,r.oid,'SET') ELSE pg_has_role(a.oid,r.oid,'MEMBER') END),'[]'::jsonb)
 ),
 'ownership',jsonb_build_object(
   'private_schema_owner',(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) FROM private),
   'private_relation_owners',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',owner_name,'objects',object_count) ORDER BY owner_name) FROM (SELECT pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,count(*) AS object_count FROM pg_class c JOIN private n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace GROUP BY c.relowner) owners),'[]'::jsonb),
   'app_owned_schemas',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN app a WHERE n.nspowner=a.oid),
   'app_owned_relations',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN app a WHERE c.relowner=a.oid),
   'app_owned_functions',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN app a WHERE p.proowner=a.oid),
   'app_owned_types',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_type t CROSS JOIN app a WHERE t.typowner=a.oid)
 ),
 'schema_access',jsonb_build_object(
   'private_usage',has_schema_privilege('dartflow_app','dartflow_private','USAGE'),
   'private_create',has_schema_privilege('dartflow_app','dartflow_private','CREATE'),
   'any_schema_create',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(n.nspname ORDER BY n.nspname) FROM pg_namespace n WHERE has_schema_privilege('dartflow_app',n.oid,'CREATE')),'[]'::jsonb),
   'database_create',has_database_privilege('dartflow_app',current_database(),'CREATE')
 ),
 'private_tables',jsonb_build_object('count',(SELECT count(*) FROM tables),'rls_enabled_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM tables WHERE relrowsecurity),'all_owners_postgres',(SELECT bool_and(pg_get_userbyid(relowner)='postgres') FROM tables)),
 'admin_table_privileges',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'table',t.relname,'select',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'SELECT'),
   'insert',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'DELETE'),
   'truncate',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'TRUNCATE'),'trigger',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'TRIGGER'),
   'insert_columns',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND has_column_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,a.attnum,'INSERT')),'[]'::jsonb),
   'update_columns',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND has_column_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,a.attnum,'UPDATE')),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) ORDER BY t.relname) FROM admin_tables t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'append_only_privileges',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'table',t.relname,'insert',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'DELETE'),'truncate',has_table_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,'TRUNCATE'),
   'update_columns',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND has_column_privilege('dartflow_app',t.oid,a.attnum,'UPDATE')),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) ORDER BY t.relname) FROM append_only t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'api_role_privileges',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'role',r.rolname,'private_schema_usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,(SELECT oid FROM private),'USAGE'),'private_schema_create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,(SELECT oid FROM private),'CREATE'),
   'tables_with_access',(SELECT count(*) FROM tables t WHERE has_table_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES')),
   'sequences_with_access',(SELECT count(*) FROM sequences s WHERE has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,s.oid,'USAGE,SELECT,UPDATE')),
   'functions_with_execute',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN private n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE'))
 ) ORDER BY r.rolname) FROM api_roles r),'[]'::jsonb)
) AS privilege_evidence;
